name: Protect the Frontier
label: Quest
description: Guard Thomas watches Elwynn's eastern bridge as predators threaten the frontier. Stormwind's forces are thin here, and wolves and bears have grown bold…

clips.title: The story
paras: Guard Thomas watches Elwynn's eastern bridge as predators threaten the frontier. Stormwind's forces are thin here, and wolves and bears have grown bold near the Eastvale Logging Camp. He asks capable adventurers to cull the beasts threatening travelers and workers.

Guard Thomas watches the bridge over the river at Elwynn Forest's eastern edge. Goldshire and the Northshire Valley have a visible Stormwind garrison, but this frontier receives far less protection. With Stormwind's forces stretched across the realm, Thomas is one of few sentries between the settled heartlands and the wilderness. Travelers help keep vital supply roads open.

Eastvale Logging Camp supplies timber to Stormwind City, but woodsmen felling trees at the forest's edge meet dangerous wildlife. Prowlers, gray forest wolves, and young forest bears now roam near roads and lumber yards. Culling them eases the danger to local workers for a time. Thomas suspects a disturbance deeper in the woods is driving the beasts toward settlements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hail, friend. Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!
We could use your help out here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you killed those wolves and bears?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks a lot for the help, friend. Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.
Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.
